title: Business Central Trivia Recap: October 5–9, 2026
summary: A recap of a Business Central trivia quiz event covering October 5-9, 2026, with 250 questions, 58% average correct answers, and statistics on which categories were hardest and easiest.
key_points: The October 5 to 9 round had 250 questions, and 58% of answers were correct, down from 61% the week before. This is the lowest of the rounds the author has numbers for.

Among categories with at least 40 answers, the hardest were Subscription Billing (36%), Fixed Assets (37%) and Sustainability (40%). The easiest were Name That Page (77%), Keyboard Shortcuts (75%) and Sales Management (74%).

Subscription Billing fell sharply from 59% the previous week. Sustainability was the hardest category for the second week in a row. Keyboard Shortcuts, which scored between 46% and 51% in earlier rounds, rose to 75%.
The trivia site got two changes: the sign-up page now shows username rules and checks the name while you type, and each page has a color stripe under the header.
